title: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation
question: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms used for subjects offered by that department, considering only rooms with an area greater than 40 and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area,
    VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS variance_area,
    STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS stddev_area
FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr
JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY dlc ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = dlc.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dlc.DLC_KEY = sd.DLC_KEY
WHERE fr.AREA > 40
  AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
  AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'
GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
